cards.name: Bigfoot
cards.badStuff: Bigfoot steps on you. Lose your Footgear. If you have no Footgear, lose a level.

cards.name: Blorc
cards.badStuff: It sits on you. Lose 2 levels.
cards.flavorText: Half Blob. Half Orc. All ugly.

cards.name: Bullrog
cards.badStuff: You die. Lose all your stuff.
cards.flavorText: It's a bull. It's a frog. It will kill you.

cards.name: Charitable Banker
cards.badStuff: He repossesses your most expensive Item. Discard it.
cards.flavorText: He just wants to help... himself to your stuff.

cards.name: Cheesy Gargoyle
cards.badStuff: Lose your headgear. If you have none, lose a level.
cards.flavorText: He looks ridiculous but he'll still mess you up.

cards.name: Crabs
cards.badStuff: Lose 1 level.
cards.flavorText: They're crabs. What do you want?

cards.name: Drooling Slime
cards.badStuff: Lose your armor. If you have none, lose a level.
cards.flavorText: It came from the dungeon floor. Or possibly the cafeteria.

cards.name: Flying Frogs
cards.badStuff: They mock you. Lose a level.

cards.name: Floating Nose
cards.badStuff: It smells you coming next time. Your next combat is at -3.
cards.flavorText: Don't ask where it came from.

cards.name: Gazebo
cards.badStuff: It is made of wood. You are not. Lose 2 levels.
cards.flavorText: I was once at a convention where I encountered a gazebo...

cards.name: Gelatinous Octahedron
cards.badStuff: It engulfs you. Lose your armor. If no armor, lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Ghoulfiend
cards.badStuff: Lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Hippogriff
cards.badStuff: It swoops you up and drops you. Lose 2 levels.
cards.flavorText: Half horse. Half griffin. All problem.

cards.name: Horthgar the Axe Maniac
cards.badStuff: He takes your biggest weapon. If no weapon, lose 3 levels.
cards.flavorText: He has many axes. He wants more.

cards.name: Insurance Salesman
cards.badStuff: He sells you a policy. Lose 3 levels.
cards.flavorText: The most terrifying monster in the dungeon.

cards.name: Lame Goblin
cards.badStuff: Lose a level.
cards.flavorText: He's lame. But he's still a goblin.

cards.name: Large Angry Chicken
cards.badStuff: It pecks you. Lose a level.

cards.name: Leprechaun
cards.badStuff: It steals your gold. Lose 2 Treasure cards at random from your hand.
cards.flavorText: He's after your Lucky Charms. And your Treasure cards.

cards.name: Maul Rat
cards.badStuff: Lose a level.
cards.flavorText: It gnaws on your ankles. And your dignity.

cards.name: Mr. Bones
cards.badStuff: He rattles at you. Lose a level.
cards.flavorText: He's got a bone to pick with you. Several, actually.

cards.name: Net Troll
cards.badStuff: He trolls you online AND offline. Lose 2 levels and discard a card.
cards.flavorText: First Hits: Lose the Item with the highest value, or your best one-handed weapon.

cards.name: Pit Bull
cards.badStuff: It mauls you. Lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Plutonium Dragon
cards.badStuff: You die instantly. Really. No saving throw.

cards.name: Potted Plant
cards.badStuff: It falls on you. Lose a level.
cards.flavorText: How did this get in the dungeon?

cards.name: Shrieking Geek
cards.badStuff: It lectures you about game mechanics. Lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Slurpy
cards.badStuff: Lose your armor. If no armor, lose a level.

cards.name: Snails of Speed
cards.badStuff: They're fast. You're slow. Lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Squidzilla
cards.badStuff: It destroys a city AND your best item. Lose your highest-value equipped item.

cards.name: Stone Golem
cards.badStuff: It crushes you. Lose 3 levels.
cards.flavorText: Rock solid. In the worst way.

cards.name: Tongue Demon
cards.badStuff: It licks off your face. Lose headgear. If no headgear, lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Undead Horse
cards.badStuff: Lose your footgear. If no footgear, lose a level.

cards.name: Unspeakably Awful Indescribable Horror
cards.badStuff: You die. All your stuff is discarded.
cards.flavorText: We'd describe it but we can't.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.badStuff: It bites you. Lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Wannabe Vampire
cards.badStuff: Lose a level.
cards.flavorText: He read too many Anne Rice novels.

cards.name: Wight Brothers
cards.badStuff: They fly you somewhere unpleasant. Lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Wizard of Ros
cards.badStuff: He turns you into something embarrassing. Lose 2 levels and discard your class card.
cards.flavorText: Pay no attention to the man behind the curtain.

cards.name: Zapped Amazon
cards.badStuff: Lose 2 levels.
cards.flavorText: She's had a very bad day. She's going to share.

cards.name: Curse! Change Sex
cards.effect: Change your sex. If your class or race has different rules for different sexes, you are now subject to the rules for your new sex.

cards.name: Curse! Chicken On Your Head
cards.effect: You have a chicken on your head. You cannot wear headgear. Discard your headgear if any. This curse lasts until another Curse affects you.

cards.name: Curse! Lose 1 Level
cards.effect: Lose 1 level.

cards.name: Curse! Lose 1 Level
cards.effect: Lose 1 level.

cards.name: Curse! Lose 2 Levels
cards.effect: Lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Curse! Lose Big Item
cards.effect: Discard your most valuable Big item. If you have none, discard your most valuable item.
cards.flavorText: At least it wasn't the really big one. Wait...

cards.name: Curse! Lose Small Item
cards.effect: Discard your most valuable small item.

cards.name: Curse! Lose the Armor You Are Wearing
cards.effect: Discard whatever armor you are currently using. If you have no armor equipped, nothing happens.

cards.name: Curse! Lose the Headgear You Are Wearing
cards.effect: Discard whatever headgear you are currently using. If you have no headgear equipped, nothing happens.
cards.flavorText: Off the top of your head.

cards.name: Curse! Lose the Footgear You Are Wearing
cards.effect: Discard whatever footgear you are currently using. If you have no footgear equipped, nothing happens.

cards.name: Curse! Lose Your Race
cards.effect: Discard your Race card. You are now human.

cards.name: Curse! Lose Your Class
cards.effect: Discard your Class card. You are now classless.
cards.flavorText: That's what they said about you in school too.

cards.name: Curse! Malign Mirror
cards.effect: This curse affects the player to your left instead of you.

cards.name: Curse! Duck of Doom
cards.effect: Lose 2 levels.

cards.name: Curse! Tax Collector
cards.effect: Lose one treasure card of the highest value in your hand. If your hand is empty, lose a level.
cards.flavorText: Death and taxes. In a dungeon.

cards.name: Cleric
abilities: You may use any one Divine Intervention card per combat.
You can Turn Undead: in combat with an undead monster, you may discard any one card to add +3 to your combat strength.
You may use any Cleric-only items.

cards.name: Thief
abilities: Once per combat (not your own), you may steal an item from another player. Roll the die: 4-6 = success, take item to your hand; 1-3 = failure, lose a level.
You may use any Thief-only items.
Backstab: once per combat, you may play this to add +2 against a monster.
cards.flavorText: Everything not nailed down is yours. Eventually.

cards.name: Warrior
abilities: You may use any Warrior-only items.
Berserking: you may discard any number of cards to add +1 per card to your combat strength for one combat.
You are not required to Charity at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Wizard
abilities: You may use any Wizard-only items.
Spells: you may discard any Spell card from your hand to add its bonus to your combat strength.
You may cast any one spell per combat.

cards.name: Dwarf
abilities: You may carry an extra Big item.
You are +2 in combat against Orcs.

cards.name: Elf
abilities: Every time you help another player kill a monster, you gain a level (in addition to any treasure).
You may use any Elf-only items.

cards.name: Halfling
abilities: You may hold two extra cards in your hand.
Once per turn, you may discard a card to Dodge: escape combat automatically with no Run Away roll needed.
cards.flavorText: Small feet. Big appetite. Surprisingly sneaky.

cards.name: Human
abilities: Humans have no special abilities.
Wait — actually you can sell items for 1 extra Gold Piece (1 extra level worth of sale value) once per turn.

cards.name: Wandering Monster
cards.effect: Play a monster from your hand. It joins the combat against the current player.

cards.name: Wandering Monster
cards.effect: Play a monster from your hand. It joins the combat against the current player.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.effect: Clerics only: add +3 to your combat strength.
cards.flavorText: The big guy upstairs has your back.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.effect: Clerics only: add +3 to your combat strength.

cards.name: Help Me Out Here!
cards.effect: Ask any one player to help you in combat. They may agree or refuse. Negotiate treasure split.
cards.flavorText: Please? I'll give you half... of the worst treasure.

cards.name: Illusion
cards.effect: The monster you are fighting is an illusion. Treat its level as 0 for this combat. You still get treasures.
cards.flavorText: It's not real. The treasure is real though.

cards.name: Look For Trouble
cards.effect: Play a monster from your hand and fight it as if you had kicked open the door and found it.

cards.name: Out To Lunch
cards.effect: Play on any monster. It is distracted and wanders off. Remove it from combat. No treasures.

cards.name: Friendship Potion
cards.effect: The monster becomes friendly. Escape without running away. No treasures, no bad stuff.

cards.name: Helm of Courage
cards.flavorText: Wearing this makes you feel brave. That's something.

cards.name: Pointy Hat of Power
cards.flavorText: Wizards only. Non-wizards just look silly.

cards.name: Tiara of Keeping Hair Tidy
cards.flavorText: It's a tiara. It works. Don't ask questions.

cards.name: Chainmail Bikini
cards.flavorText: Provides minimal coverage and maximum bonus.

cards.name: Mithril Armor
cards.flavorText: Light as a feather. Strong as a really strong thing.

cards.name: Kneepads of Allure
cards.specialEffect: Once per combat, you may use these to ask any one player for help without negotiating. They may still refuse.
cards.flavorText: The power of knee protection and interpersonal charm.

cards.name: Boots of Running Really Fast
cards.specialEffect: You automatically succeed at Run Away attempts. No die roll needed.
cards.flavorText: Discretion: the better part of valor.

cards.name: Dagger of Treachery
cards.flavorText: Stab first. Ask questions later. Skip questions.

cards.name: Short Sword
cards.flavorText: Short. Stabby. Gets the job done.

cards.name: Mace of Sharpness
cards.flavorText: Technically a mace isn't sharp but details.

cards.name: Wand of Dowsing
cards.flavorText: Points toward treasure. Also useful as a stick.

cards.name: Halberd of Slaying
cards.flavorText: Warriors only. It's huge. It's great.

cards.name: Rapier of Unfair Advantage
cards.flavorText: All advantages are fair if you win.

cards.name: Eleven-Foot Pole
cards.specialEffect: You would not touch this with a ten-foot pole. Good thing you have an eleven-foot one.
cards.flavorText: One foot longer than the standard adventuring pole.

cards.name: Staff of Napalm
cards.flavorText: Wizards only. It sets everything on fire. Everything.

cards.name: Singing & Dancing Sword
cards.flavorText: It performs. You fight. Partnership goals.

cards.name: Huge Rock
cards.flavorText: It's a rock. It's huge. Smash.

cards.name: Tuba of Charm
cards.specialEffect: Once per turn, play this before combat to ask for help. The target must say yes or lose a level.
cards.flavorText: The most persuasive instrument in the dungeon.

cards.name: Cloak of Obscurity
cards.specialEffect: Thieves only: your steal attempts are at +2.

cards.name: Boots of Running Really Fast
cards.specialEffect: You automatically succeed at Run Away attempts. No die roll needed.
cards.flavorText: A second pair, in case the first pair runs away.

cards.name: Shield of Ubiquity
cards.flavorText: It's everywhere. It's here. It's a shield.

cards.name: Potion of Halitosis
cards.flavorText: Breathe on the monster. It recoils. You win.

cards.name: Pollymorph Potion
cards.specialEffect: Play during combat: the monster becomes a different random monster. Draw a new monster from the Door deck. The new monster replaces the old one.

cards.name: Spiky Knees
cards.flavorText: Knee spikes. For when regular knees just aren't enough.

cards.name: Really Impressive Title
cards.specialEffect: This item has no gold value. It gives +3 in combat against any monster that responds to authority.

cards.name: Cotion of Ponfusion
cards.specialEffect: Play during combat: the monster is confused. It loses 5 levels for this combat.
cards.flavorText: Not to be confused with a Potion of Confusion.

cards.name: Magic Lamp
cards.specialEffect: Discard this card to gain 3 levels. Cannot be used to win the game.

cards.name: Boil and Bubble
cards.specialEffect: Wizards only. Play during combat to add +5 to your combat strength.

cards.name: Transferral Potion
cards.effect: Transfer any one Bad Stuff penalty from yourself to any other player currently in the combat.

cards.name: Instant Wall
cards.effect: Play to escape from combat automatically. No Run Away roll needed. Cannot be used if you are Level 10 and would win.

cards.name: Potion of General Studliness
cards.effect: Add +2 to your combat strength for one combat.

cards.name: Potion of General Studliness
cards.effect: Add +2 to your combat strength for one combat.

cards.name: Wishing Ring
cards.effect: Cancel any one Curse that just affected you.
cards.flavorText: You get one wish. Use it wisely.

cards.name: Wishing Ring
cards.effect: Cancel any one Curse that just affected you.

cards.name: Invisibility Potion
cards.effect: You become invisible. Escape from combat automatically. Alternatively, add +4 to your combat strength.

cards.name: Loaded Die
cards.effect: Reroll any one die roll and take the better result.

cards.name: Loaded Die
cards.effect: Reroll any one die roll and take the better result.

cards.name: Potion of Idiotic Courage
cards.effect: Add +3 to your combat strength. However, you may not run away from this combat.

cards.name: Potion of Idiotic Courage
cards.effect: Add +3 to your combat strength. However, you may not run away from this combat.

cards.name: Flamboyant Armor
cards.effect: Add +3 to your combat strength. Can only be played if you are wearing no armor.

cards.name: Yuppie Water
cards.effect: Gain 1 level.

cards.name: Yuppie Water
cards.effect: Gain 1 level.

cards.name: Annihilate
cards.effect: Add +5 to your combat strength for one combat.

cards.name: Enhancements
cards.effect: Add +3 to any one item's bonus for one combat.

cards.name: Fire and Ice
cards.effect: Add +4 to your combat strength.

cards.name: Magic Missile
cards.effect: Add +5 to your combat strength.

cards.name: Steal a Level
cards.effect: Play against any player. They lose a level, you gain a level.
cards.flavorText: Level theft. Technically legal in dungeons.

cards.name: Cheat!
cards.effect: Play to ignore any one restriction on any one item you are using right now.
cards.flavorText: It's not cheating if nobody catches you.

cards.name: Cheat!
cards.effect: Play to ignore any one restriction on any one item you are using right now.

cards.name: Tripe Potion
cards.effect: Play on any monster. It loses 5 levels for this combat.
cards.flavorText: Feed it this. Watch it wilt.

cards.name: Whine at the GM
cards.effect: Gain 1 level. All other players lose 1 level. This card can only be played once per game.

cards.name: Nasty Tasting Sports Drink
cards.effect: Add +2 to your combat strength.
cards.flavorText: Tastes like regret. Works like a charm.

cards.name: Nasty Tasting Sports Drink
cards.effect: Add +2 to your combat strength.

cards.name: Helpful Item
cards.effect: Add +2 to your combat strength.

cards.name: Instant Meat
cards.effect: Distract a monster. It wanders off. No treasures, no bad stuff. Cannot be used against a monster you must fight.
cards.flavorText: Every monster has a price. For most, it's meat.

cards.name: Open Sesame
cards.effect: Look through either discard pile and take any one card.

cards.name: Go Up a Level
cards.effect: Gain 1 level. Cannot be used to win the game.

cards.name: Go Up a Level
cards.effect: Gain 1 level. Cannot be used to win the game.

cards.name: Go Up a Level
cards.effect: Gain 1 level. Cannot be used to win the game.

cards.name: Go Up a Level
cards.effect: Gain 1 level. Cannot be used to win the game.

cards.name: Enraged
cards.modifier: +5 to monster level, Bad Stuff is worse
cards.flavorText: It's having a VERY bad day.

cards.name: Intelligent
cards.flavorText: It thinks. That's bad for you.

cards.name: Undead
cards.modifier: Monster is now Undead. Clerics get +3 against it.

cards.name: Mate
cards.modifier: There are two of them. Double the monster's level.
cards.flavorText: There is one. And also its mate.

cards.name: Sword of Slaying Everything Except Squid
cards.specialEffect: Adds +6 against any monster EXCEPT aquatic/squid monsters.

cards.name: Limburger and Anchovy Sandwich
cards.flavorText: Smell it. Fight with it. Win.

cards.name: Leather Codpiece
cards.flavorText: Male characters only. Stylish and protective.

cards.name: Stepladder
cards.flavorText: Reach the upper shelves. Fight at eye level.

cards.name: Good Taste
cards.effect: Play to cancel a Cheat! card that another player just played.
cards.flavorText: Some people have it. Some don't.

cards.name: Transferral Potion
cards.effect: Transfer any one Bad Stuff penalty from yourself to any other player in the combat.
cards.flavorText: Not my problem. Your problem now.
